rules: password + confirmation only; username is never required
cryptographic metadata never appears as an input
readiness checklist is skippable/reopenable and blocks only dependent actions
password never retained in recoverable working copy
auto-login success enters same bounded session model
auto-login enable re-prompts password and explains Windows-user binding
recovery secret never enters URL/navigation state
restore preview distinguishes source instance/schema/app compatibility and exact artifact digest
failure before replacement states explicitly that live data was not changed
preview names categories/counts rather than exposing raw prohibited content

security_interaction.deliberate_action: visible monotonic three-second progress from LLD-10; server-issued proof completes only after elapsed minimum and remains single-use

accessibility: credential errors use text not color alone
secrets shown once have explicit copy/acknowledge semantics without auto-clipboard persistence
